# DevFlow Technology (https://devflow.co.in)

> DevFlow Technology is a premier AI Development Agency, Custom Software Development Company, and IT Services Provider based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

## Summary
DevFlow Technology specializes in delivering high-performance AI solutions, Generative AI integration, enterprise ERP systems, custom web applications, mobile apps (iOS/Android), cloud infrastructure, and technical SEO services for global clients across India, US, UK, UAE, and Australia.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Artificial Intelligence & Generative AI Solutions
- **Custom LLM Integration & Fine-Tuning**: Integration of OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Llama 3 models into enterprise workflows.
- **RAG Systems (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)**: Knowledge base vector search engines built with Pinecone, Qdrant, and PGVector.
- **AI Automation & Agents**: Autonomous workflow agents for customer support, document parsing, lead qualification, and data extraction.
- **AI Chatbots**: Multi-lingual conversational assistants supporting English, Hindi, and Gujarati.

### 2. Custom Web Development & SaaS Architecture
- **Technologies**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL, TailwindCSS.
- **Services**: Headless web applications, SaaS platform development, multi-tenant database isolation, Stripe payment integrations, performance optimization.

### 3. Enterprise ERP & Software Development
- **Services**: Custom ERP, CRM, inventory management, supply chain tracking, automated invoice billing systems for manufacturing and services enterprises.

### 4. Mobile Application Development
- **Technologies**: Flutter, React Native, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android).
- **Services**: Native performance mobile apps, offline-first sync architecture, push notifications, cross-platform mobile products.

### 5. Technical SEO & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
- **Services**: Technical SEO audits, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data implementation, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for ChatGPT and Perplexity citation indexing.
